details.description: Foxnuts are the seeds of the lotus flower. They are grown in water and are largely found in India, where they are known as 'Makhana.' Makhanas are gluten-free, protein-rich, and high in carbohydrates. The beauty of these seeds lies in their versatility. You can roast the seeds or fry them in a little ghee, where they pop and resemble popcorn. These puffed seeds can be tossed with some black salt and enjoyed as a snack.
